evals.prompt: Implement roadmap item M1.9 in the backoffice
assertions: creates a worktree on a task branch from develop
writes or extends a failing test before the implementation
runs npm run check and reports the real result
opens the PR into develop, not main

evals.prompt: Change the invitation flow so invitations expire after 7 days
assertions: adds a new append-only file in migrations/ instead of editing an applied one
keeps requireActor on the server action and the verified e-mail binding
runs npm run test:db or reports it as not run
does not touch the API repository

evals.prompt: Show the new latency value on the operations dashboard
assertions: validates the payload at the adapter against the pinned contract
renders 'No disponible' for missing values, never zero
ends with the output template and lists what was not verified
